title: ListClustersResponse
description: Paginated list of clusters in the organization.

Cluster.description: Represents a CockroachDB Cloud cluster, which is an instance of CockroachDB running in one or more cloud regions on Serverless or Dedicated infrastructure.

cloud_provider.description: Cloud infrastructure provider hosting the cluster.

cockroach_version.description: Version of CockroachDB running on the cluster.

operation_status.description: Current operational status of the cluster.

regions.description: Cloud provider regions where the cluster is deployed.

creator_id.description: Identifier of the user who created the cluster.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the cluster was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the cluster was deleted, if applicable.

sql_dns.description: DNS hostname for SQL connections to the cluster.

upgrade_status.description: Status of any in-progress version upgrade.

account_id.description: Cloud provider account ID associated with the cluster.

parent_id.description: ID of the folder containing this cluster, if any.

delete_protection.description: Whether delete protection is enabled on the cluster.

egress_traffic_policy.description: Policy governing outbound traffic from the cluster.

network_visibility.description: Network accessibility configuration of the cluster.

ClusterConfig.description: Configuration settings for a CockroachDB cluster.

DedicatedClusterConfig.description: Configuration specific to CockroachDB Dedicated clusters.

machine_type.description: Machine type used for cluster nodes.

num_virtual_cpus.description: Number of virtual CPUs per node.

storage_gib.description: Storage capacity per node in gibibytes.

PaginationResponse.description: Pagination metadata included in list responses.

next.description: Token or cursor for retrieving the next page of results.

last.description: Token or cursor for the last page of results.

time.description: Server time at which the paginated query was executed.

Region.description: A geographic region where the cluster or its nodes are deployed.

sql_dns.description: DNS hostname for SQL connections routed to this region.

node_count.description: Number of nodes in this region.

ServerlessClusterConfig.description: Configuration specific to CockroachDB Serverless clusters.

spend_limit.description: Monthly spend limit in US cents. 0 means no limit.

routing_id.description: Unique routing identifier for the serverless cluster.

usage_limits.description: Usage-based limits for request units and storage.
